title: Accelerated Onramp Package test + automated Enterprise SQ trigger
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Run a multi-arm experiment to test an "accelerated onramp" credit package that increases early activation and speeds PLG-to-paid conversion. The feature couples a short-term 'momentum bonus' (conditional extra credits unlocked when a user reaches usage milestones in the first 7 days) with automated Enterprise Security Questionnaire (SQ) orchestration when signals indicate a high-value account. This ticket covers experiment configuration, instrumentation, fraud/abuse guardrails, and the automation flow to create an SQ task and notify Sales/SEs.
hypothesis: If new users receive a front-loaded credit package plus a conditional momentum bonus that extends their trial window upon early engagement, then activation (first meaningful request within 48h) and 30-day paid conversion will increase versus baseline while keeping credit burn ROI-positive for high-LTV cohorts.
metrics: Primary: 7d activation rate (first meaningful generation), 30d paid conversion rate. Secondary: credits burned per activated user, CAC-adjusted conversion lift, early churn (14d), SQ triggers per 1k signups. Guardrail: cost per converted user should not exceed 1.8x baseline and fraud rate < 1%.
experiment_design: Three arms randomized at signup: 1) Baseline free tier (current default). 2) Frontloaded + no bonus: double initial credits, same 30d expiry. 3) Frontloaded + momentum bonus: double initial credits + conditional bonus (extra 50% credits) unlocked if user issues >= 3 meaningful requests in first 7 days; bonus also extends expiry by 7 days. Cohorts split 30/35/35. Segmentation by industry, ARR proxy (email domain), and region to detect heterogeneous effects.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 — Feature flag + internal QA (week 1). Phase 1 — 2k new signups random sample (1 week) with tight monitoring. Phase 2 — Gradual ramp (25% traffic) for 2 weeks if guardrails pass. Phase 3 — Full rollout. Enterprise SQ automation on pilot for accounts meeting high-value signals (>=50k ARR proxy) only during Phase 2+. Immediate kill switch on unusual credit burn patterns or spikes in fraud metrics.
risks: Frontloading credits could be abused by scripted signups — mitigated by device fingerprinting and rate limits.
Momentum bonus extension may distort retention signals for cohorts; require label in DB to distinguish experiment users.
SQ automation could surface incomplete information to Sales; include pre-flight validation and manual handoff option.
decisions: Run 3-arm randomized experiment (30/35/35) rather than sequential A/B to reduce temporal confounding.
Limit SQ automation to ARR-proxy >= 50k for pilot to avoid noise and ops load.
Require security review before Phase 2 because automation touches PII (email domain inference) and KMS metadata.
